newsitem.title: ROMANIA: RADIO ROMANIA AFTERNOON HEADLINES AT 1 PM.
newsitem.headline: RADIO ROMANIA AFTERNOON HEADLINES AT 1 PM.

text.p: * Central Electoral Bureau (BEC) announced a 10.26 percent turnout at 1000 local (0800 GMT) in Sunday's presidential run-off voting.
* Top BEC official said some private televisions had aired inaccurate reports about voting procedures.

* Incumbent president Ion Iliescu said he had voted with faith in the Romanian electorate. His challenger, Emil Constantinescu, voted with his family, and said he was confident that voters would vote well.

Adrian Nastase, executive president of the Party of Social Democracy said Sunday's vote was a test for Romania's political class. Former prime minister Petre Roman said he expected voters to choose Romania's change for the better.
* By 1200 local (1000 gmt) army conscripts had voted in a proportion of 56 percent at the 206 polling stations in military barracks around Romania.
